binds.giver: the one who asks for help
binds.village: the village the tale happens in

stages.journal: {giver} asks you to find the ferryman of {village}.
stages.canvas: The lord rubs his eyes. His ferryman at {village} has not been seen for a week, and the ferry sits idle on the river.
facts: The ferryman has been missing for a week.

{giver}: Your ferryman at {village} has vanished, and you cannot spare men to look.

choices.label: Ask in the village
canvas: The villagers lower their voices: the ferryman owed money to a man from the city.
Nobody has seen him since the debt fell due.

locals_of:{village}: The ferryman owed money to a moneylender from the city.

scene.title: The river at night

opening.canvas: Fog lies on the river. Somewhere downstream, a lantern moves along the bank.
facts: The ferry is tied up and empty.

findings.text: The ferryman's own lantern, still warm, dropped in the reeds.

hazards.trigger: hurrying along the bank in the dark

scene.closing: You leave the bank before dawn.

stages.canvas: A barge is moored below the village. The moneylender's men keep the ferryman there until his debt is paid.

choices.label: Free the ferryman
choices.canvas: The ferryman comes home with you, thin but alive.

choices.label: Tell the lord where he is
choices.journal: Tell the lord where he is.
choices.canvas: The lord sends his men to the barge at once.

freed.memory: The player freed my ferryman from a moneylender's barge.

told_the_lord.memory: The player found where the moneylender held my ferryman.

back_to_the_village.journal: You let the river keep its secret.

notes: The story's JavaScript is not imported: a written tale runs no script.
passage 'What the village says': <<print $heard_of_debt>> is not mapped; it was left out.
passage 'What the village says': <<audio "river" play>> is not mapped; it was left out.
